title: ALL CAPS: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: The production ledgers moved this week, one pass across the market read, the photo rights, and the running list of open questions.
A new on-camera interview landed in the archive, fresh voice material to draw on for the revision.
No new research intakes this week, the time went to production, photo rights, and lining up the images.
chapterHighlights: The teal and purple years, when several leagues at once decided a cap should look like that.
The flat brim that keeps its sticker, and the era that ran with it.
The single letter on the crown, a whole city carried in one monogram.
Cap giveaway night at the ballpark, the promotion that packed the seats.
